title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Lapsed Reservations and Deposit Refunds on Hold Expiry
content:
**Standard.** A reservation under Vehicle Purchase Agreements that is still reserved at the end of its hold expiration date lapses. The order moves to expired with the closure reason reservation lapsed, it closes on the day after the hold expiration date, and the vehicle returns to inventory.

**Deposit on a lapsed reservation.** When the program's deposit refund on hold expiry switch is true, the full held deposit is refunded to the original channel within the program's deposit refund business days; nothing is retained.

**Status for a deposit refund.** A deposit refund is posted only on an order whose status is expired or cancelled.

**No revival.** A lapsed order cannot be revived; the customer reserves again.

**Limits on every deposit refund.** Deposit refunds are never split across channels, and they never exceed the deposit Kestrel still holds for the order.

**Restated as conditions and effects.**

| Condition on the order | Effect |
|---|---|
| Status still reserved at the end of the hold expiration date | lapses to expired; closure reason reservation lapsed; vehicle back to inventory |
| Lapsed, and the program's refund-on-expiry switch is true | the full held deposit goes back to its original channel within the program's deposit refund business days |
| Status reserved, contracted or delivered | no deposit refund is posted |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Kestrel Value Line reservation with hold expiration on day 3 and a $250.00 deposit paid by credit card remains unsigned at the end of day 3. It closes on day 4 as expired, and the $250.00 goes back to that credit card in one refund, within 5 business days.
